svg.title: Basina — Healthcare without borders
svg.desc: Basina digital health platform: online doctor consultations, appointment booking, AI-assisted lab interpretation and electronic health records. Built in Iran, expanding across the Persian Gulf and West Asia.
svg.text: TELEMEDICINE · AI TRIAGE · ELECTRONIC HEALTH RECORDS
Licensed specialists, AI-assisted clarity, and a health record that follows you.
Built in Iran — expanding across the Persian Gulf, West Asia, and beyond.
